title: Prove hosted machine code routing to the engine
text: The engine accepts a preissued match code through machine_authorization.handoff with explicit engine org scope; handoff_poll reuses domain polling and personal approval and single-use credential delivery. The hosted consumer must adopt both explicit-org payloads after organization selection and prove its real routes against the exact merged engine candidate. Engine source tests do not prove hosted route adoption; the linked Platform machine-admission work owns that integration and its deployed proof.
